decisions.thought: Choice Scarf Gholdengo applies huge immediate pressure on their team, while Primarina and Mimikyu offer critical Dragon immunities and revenge killing capabilities.

Rotom-W provides speed control and threatens Volcarona and opposing Primarina, while Primarina covers the opposing dragons. Kingambit gives me a strong answer to Mimikyu and Gholdengo, so this trio has the broadest matchup coverage.
Gholdengo holds Choice Scarf, guaranteeing it outspeeds Rotom-Wash. Shadow Ball provides reliable neutral STAB damage without lowering Special Attack or giving free switches to the opponent's bench.

Hydro Pump threatens both Gholdengo and a possible Garchomp switch-in, while Volt Switch would fail outright if Garchomp comes in. The deciding factor is covering that likely Ground-type pivot with a strong attack.
